categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Jiangfeng Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets, semiconductor precision components, and third-generation semiconductor key materials. The sputtering targets include aluminum, titanium, tantalum, copper, and various ultra-high purity metal alloys used in semiconductor chip manufacturing, flat panel displays, and solar cells. Semiconductor precision components are made from metals, ceramics, and resins, serving semiconductor chip and flat panel display production equipment. Third-generation semiconductor materials focus on copper-clad ceramic substrates and silicon carbide epitaxial wafers for power devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced metallurgical purification, crystal grain and orientation control, special welding, precision machining, surface treatment, and cleaning technologies for sputtering target production. Manufacturing methods include physical vapor deposition (PVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), hot isostatic pressing (HIP), and chemical mechanical polishing (CMP). It has developed proprietary equipment for target plastic processing, welding, and surface treatment, and maintains a CNAS-certified analytical laboratory for quality control. The production model is customer-customized, supporting multi-variety, small-batch flexible manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading global semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC, SMIC, SK Hynix, UMC, and BOE, serving the integrated circuit, flat panel display, and solar cell industries. The company also supplies semiconductor equipment manufacturers with precision components. Its third-generation semiconductor materials target emerging sectors including new energy vehicles, rail transit, ultra-high voltage power systems, and 5G communications. The markets served are primarily high-end semiconductor fabrication and advanced electronics manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and multiple production bases in Zhejiang, Anhui, Guangdong, Hunan, Hubei, Shanghai, and other provinces. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and South Korea, with a newly established production facility planned in South Korea. Its sales and technical support network covers Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America, reflecting a global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Jiangfeng Electronic Materials is positioned upstream and midstream in the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the production of critical raw materials (ultra-high purity metal targets) and precision components used in semiconductor wafer fabrication and packaging equipment. It also extends into third-generation semiconductor materials, supplying key substrates and epitaxial wafers. The company integrates metallurgical processing, precision manufacturing, and material innovation, serving as a core materials supplier to chip manufacturers and equipment makers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment to maintain technological leadership in ultra-high purity sputtering targets and semiconductor precision components. It focuses on developing materials for advanced process nodes (14nm and below), including high-purity tungsten, tantalum, and copper-manganese alloy targets. It is expanding into third-generation semiconductor materials such as copper-clad ceramic substrates and silicon carbide epitaxial wafers. The firm also emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and global production capacity expansion to support strategic growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets, semiconductor precision components, and third-generation semiconductor materials. The company employs a direct sales model with some agency sales, especially in Japan through trading companies. Sales are based on customized orders aligned with customer specifications, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control to customers. The company also earns income from investment holdings and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Jiangfeng Electronic Materials is a leading domestic player in China’s high-purity sputtering target industry and ranks second globally in the wafer manufacturing sputtering target market according to Frost & Sullivan. It competes internationally with major multinational companies from the US and Japan. The company leverages its technological innovation, product quality, and customer relationships to maintain a strong competitive position and is expanding into semiconductor precision components and third-generation semiconductor materials to broaden its market footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved consolidated operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.6 billion, an 11.89% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 255 million, a slight decrease of 3.35%. The company’s total assets grew by 23.01% to over RMB 6.27 billion, reflecting ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. R&D expenses increased by 37.87% to RMB 171.7 million, underscoring its commitment to innovation. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding market share and diversified product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership in producing ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets with precise crystal grain and orientation control, advanced welding, and high cleanliness standards, ensuring superior product quality and reliability. Its ability to customize products to meet stringent customer specifications and adapt to evolving semiconductor process nodes differentiates it from competitors. The integrated product portfolio spanning sputtering targets, precision components, and third-generation semiconductor materials provides comprehensive solutions to customers. Additionally, its global sales and technical support network and commitment to quality innovation enhance customer satisfaction and market competitiveness.
